hypothesis: The fine-pitch oracle is goal-sized but a wrong hard route is much more costly than a correct route is beneficial. Apply a pitcher-by-fine-type control correction only when separate tagged-type and auto-type selectors agree with high confidence; abstain to exact-C everywhere else.

selectors.models: the fixed CatBoost tagged and auto fine-pitch selectors from V5_FINE_PITCHTYPE_LATENT_V1
selectors.route_type: top-1 type only when tagged-selector top-1 equals auto-selector top-1
selectors.confidence: minimum of the two selectors' top-1 probabilities
selectors.abstention: if selectors disagree or confidence is below threshold, use exact-C unchanged

control_profile.hard_direction: selected fine-type control level minus the pitcher's historical repertoire-weighted expected control level

source_grid.application: add gamma times hard_direction on eligible R rows, clip to [0.000001, 0.999999], and preserve exact-C on abstained R and all F rows
selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
higher confidence threshold, smaller gamma, larger shrinkage, tagged profile

source_gate.on_pass: freeze one route and correction recipe before 2022 and 2023 development
